integrity: Symbolic descent proof combined with explicit finite inverse-totient enumeration under a proven universal cutoff; standalone Python 3 checker and saved output are included.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to shift 3, provides no universal exact preperiod formula, and uses an exhaustive inverse-totient table after a proven bound of 1800. Unindexed equivalent calculations may exist. Independent audit not performed.
title: Complete cofinite-attractor classification for the three-shifted Euler totient map
